import json
import math


def is_prime(n):
    if n < 2:
        return False
    i = 2
    while i * i <= n:
        if n % i == 0:
            return False
        i += 1
    return True


def colon(a, b):
    # a : b = (a + a) * b if b < 2 else (b + b) * a
    return (a + a) * b if b < 2 else (b + b) * a


def cross(a, b):
    # a >< b = a * b if (a : b) > 0 else (-a) * (-b)
    return a * b if colon(a, b) > 0 else (-a) * (-b)


def tilde(a, b):
    # a ~ b = a - b if gcd(a, b) == 1 else gcd(a, b)
    g = math.gcd(a, b)
    return a - b if g == 1 else g


def bang(a, b):
    # a ! b = min(a, b) if either is prime else max(a, b)
    return min(a, b) if (is_prime(a) or is_prime(b)) else max(a, b)

    # a # b = a - b if (a ~ b) > 0 else a : b
    return a - b if tilde(a, b) > 0 else colon(a, b)
